blocks.text: Yeh chapter 6 (Chemical Energetics) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 The study of the quantity of heat energy absorbed or evolved during physical or chemical changes is called:
(Physical ya chemical tabdeeliyon mein jazb ya kharij hone wali heat energy ki miqdaar ke mutaale ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Thermochemistry (jise energetics bhi kehte hain) physical ya chemical tabdeeli mein jazb ya kharij heat ka mutaala hai (6.1).

book_ref.quote: Thermochemistry is the study of the quantity of heat energy absorbed or evolved

blocks.prompt:
2 Thermochemistry is largely based on:
(Thermochemistry zyada tar kis par mabni hai?)

options.text: first law of thermodynamics (harkiyat-e-hararat ka pehla qanoon)

blocks.explanation: Energetics zyada tar first law of thermodynamics par mabni hai; Hess's law isi ka khaas case hai (6.1).

book_ref.quote: is largely based on the first law of thermodynamics

blocks.prompt:
3 The energy possessed by a substance due to its structure (types of bonds) and physical state is called its:
(Kisi substance ki structure (bonds ki qisam) aur physical state ki wajah se us mein maujood energy ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Heat content ya enthalpy (H) woh energy hai jo substance ki structure aur physical state ki wajah se hoti hai (6.1).

book_ref.quote: due to its structure (types of bonds) and physical state is called its heat content or enthalpy

blocks.prompt:
4 If the heat content of the products is 120 kJ and that of the reactants is 250 kJ, ΔH for the reaction is:
(Agar products ka heat content 120 kJ aur reactants ka 250 kJ ho to reaction ka ΔH kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: ΔH = HP – HR = 120 – 250 = –130 kJ; HP < HR hai, is liye reaction exothermic hai (6.1).

book_ref.quote: the total enthalpy of products (HP) is never equal to that of reactants (HR)

blocks.prompt:
5 When HP < HR for a reaction, ΔH carries:
(Jab kisi reaction mein HP < HR ho to ΔH ka sign kya hota hai?)

options.text: positive sign aur heat jazb hoti hai
negative sign aur heat jazb hoti hai
negative sign aur heat kharij hoti hai

blocks.explanation: HP < HR ka matlab enthalpy kam hoti hai; heat kharij hoti hai aur ΔH manfi (negative) hota hai (6.1).

book_ref.quote: HP < HR: such reactions involve a lowering of enthalpy

blocks.prompt:
6 A chemical reaction or a physical change in which heat is evolved from the system to the surroundings is called:
(Woh chemical reaction ya physical tabdeeli jis mein heat system se surroundings ki taraf kharij ho, kya kehlati hai?)

options.text: exothermic process (harart kharij karne wala amal)

blocks.explanation: System se surroundings ki taraf heat kharij ho to woh exothermic process hai (6.1).

book_ref.quote: in which heat is evolved from the system to surroundings is called exothermic process

blocks.prompt:
7 In an endothermic reaction:
(Endothermic reaction mein:)
blocks.explanation: Endothermic reaction mein enthalpy barhti hai (HP > HR), heat jazb hoti hai aur ΔH positive hota hai (6.1).

book_ref.quote: HP > HR: such reactions involve an increase in enthalpy

blocks.prompt:
8 Which of the following is an exothermic reaction given in the chapter?
(In mein se kaunsa reaction chapter mein exothermic ki misaal hai?)

options.text: NH₄Cl ka paani mein hal hona

blocks.explanation: C(s) + O₂(g) → CO₂(g), ΔH = –393.7 kJ mol⁻¹, exothermic hai; baqi heat jazb karte hain (6.1).

book_ref.quote: For example, combustion of carbon in oxygen is an exothermic reaction.

blocks.prompt:
9 Cold packs used to treat internal injuries work because the dissolution of NH₄Cl in water is:
(Andaruni chot ke ilaaj mein istemal hone wale cold packs is liye kaam karte hain ke NH₄Cl ka paani mein hal hona:)

options.text: exothermic hai, energy kharij karta hai
endothermic hai, surroundings se energy jazb karta hai

blocks.explanation: NH₄Cl aur paani milne par energy jazb hoti hai (ΔH = +16.2 kJ mol⁻¹), is liye thandak mehsoos hoti hai (6.1).

book_ref.quote: This reaction is used in cold packs (or ice packs) to treat internal injuries.

blocks.prompt:
10 According to the energy profile idea, in all chemical reactions:
(Energy profile ke tasawwur ke mutabiq, tamam chemical reactions mein:)

options.text: naye bonds se pehle reactants ke bonds tootte hain
purane bonds tootne se pehle naye bante hain

blocks.explanation: Naye bonds banne se pehle reactants ke bonds tootte hain; is ke liye kaafi energy wali takkar chahiye (6.2).

book_ref.quote: All chemical reactions involve the breaking of bonds in the reactant molecules before the formation of new bonds.

blocks.prompt:
11 The minimum amount of energy required by reactant molecules just to cross the energy barrier is called:
(Reactant molecules ko energy barrier paar karne ke liye kam az kam jo energy chahiye use kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Ea woh kam az kam energy hai jo energy barrier paar karne ke liye chahiye (6.2).

book_ref.quote: This minimum amount of energy required by the reactant molecules just to cross that energy barrier

blocks.prompt:
12 Bonds in reactant molecules can be broken only if the molecules:
(Reactant molecules ke bonds sirf tab toot sakte hain jab molecules:)
blocks.explanation: Bond sirf tab tootte hain jab molecules itni energy se takrayein ke barrier paar ho jaye (6.2).

book_ref.quote: This can be achieved only if the reactant molecules collide with sufficient amount of energy

blocks.prompt:
13 The standard conditions for measuring standard enthalpy changes are:
(Standard enthalpy changes naapne ki standard conditions kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Standard conditions: 25 °C (298 K) aur 1 atm (101 kPa) (6.3).

book_ref.quote: Temperature: 25 °C or 298 K

blocks.prompt:
14 The standard state of carbon is:
(Carbon ki standard state kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Standard state 298 K aur 1 atm par sab se mustahkam shakal hai; carbon ki graphite hai, diamond nahi (6.3).

book_ref.quote: the standard state of C is graphite not diamond

blocks.prompt:
15 The standard enthalpy change of formation of O₂(g) is:
(O₂(g) ki standard enthalpy change of formation kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: Definition ke mutabiq kisi bhi element ki standard state mein ΔH°f zero hoti hai (6.3).

book_ref.quote: the standard enthalpy change of formation of any element in its standard state is zero

blocks.prompt:
16 Enthalpy changes must be compared under standard conditions because the enthalpy of a substance depends on:
(Enthalpy changes ka muqabla standard conditions par kyun hota hai? Kyun ke substance ki enthalpy depend karti hai:)

options.text: physical state, pressure aur temperature par

blocks.explanation: Enthalpy physical state, pressure aur temperature par depend karti hai, is liye yeh standard rakhe jate hain (6.3).

book_ref.quote: The enthalpy of a substance not only depends upon its physical state but also on the pressure and temperature.

blocks.prompt:
17 The standard enthalpy of reaction is the enthalpy change when:
(Standard enthalpy of reaction woh enthalpy change hai jab:)

options.text: aik mole compound apne elements se bane
aik mole substance zyada oxygen mein jale
acid aur alkali se aik mole paani bane
stoichiometric miqdaar mein reactants apni standard states mein standard conditions par poora react karein

blocks.explanation: Yeh standard enthalpy of reaction ki definition hai; baqi formation, combustion aur neutralization ki hain (6.3.1).

book_ref.quote: stoichiometric amounts of reactants in their standard states react together completely

blocks.prompt:
18 The standard enthalpy change of combustion refers to:
(Standard enthalpy change of combustion kis cheez se mutaliq hai?)

options.text: aik mole oxygen ka kharch hona
aik gram substance ka hawa mein jalna
aik mole substance ka zyada oxygen mein poori tarah jalna
elements se aik mole CO₂ banna

blocks.explanation: ΔH°c aik mole substance ke zyada oxygen mein poori tarah jalne ke liye hai, standard conditions par (6.3.2).

book_ref.quote: completely burnt in excess of oxygen, under standard conditions

blocks.prompt:
19 The standard enthalpy change of combustion of a substance is:
(Kisi substance ki standard enthalpy change of combustion hoti hai:)
blocks.explanation: Combustion hamesha heat kharij karta hai, maslan ethanol ka ΔH°c = –1368 kJ mol⁻¹ (6.3.2).

book_ref.quote: It is always exothermic. For example, standard enthalpy of combustion

blocks.prompt:
20 Enthalpy change of combustion is especially useful for calculating:
(Enthalpy change of combustion khaas tor par kis cheez ke hisaab mein kaam aati hai?)

options.text: khurak aur fuels ka calorie content

blocks.explanation: ΔH°c se khurak aur fuels ka calorie content nikala jata hai (6.3.2).

book_ref.quote: Enthalpy change of combustion is useful in calculating calorie content of foods and fuels.

blocks.prompt:
21 Which equation represents the standard enthalpy change of formation of methane?
(Kaunsi equation methane ki standard enthalpy change of formation zahir karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Formation: elements (standard states) se aik mole compound: C(s) + 2H₂(g) → CH₄(g), ΔH°f = –74.8 kJ mol⁻¹ (6.3.3).

book_ref.quote: one mole of the compound is formed from its elements under standard conditions

blocks.prompt:
22 The standard enthalpy change of formation of a compound:
(Kisi compound ki standard enthalpy change of formation:)

options.text: exothermic ya endothermic dono ho sakti hai

blocks.explanation: ΔH°f ka sign dono ho sakta hai; maslan CH₄ –74.8 kJ mol⁻¹, C₂H₄ +52.2 kJ mol⁻¹ (6.3.3, 6.8).

book_ref.quote: It can be exothermic or endothermic. For instance

blocks.prompt:
23 The H–H bond energy is +436 kJ mol⁻¹. The standard enthalpy change of atomization of hydrogen is:
(H–H bond energy +436 kJ mol⁻¹ hai. Hydrogen ki standard enthalpy change of atomization kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: Atomization mein aik mole gaseous atoms bante hain: ½H₂(g) → H(g), is liye ΔH°at = 436/2 = +218 kJ mol⁻¹ (6.3.4).

book_ref.quote: when one mole of gaseous atoms is formed from the element, under standard conditions

blocks.prompt:
24 Using the Cl–Cl bond energy of 243 kJ mol⁻¹ (Table 6.1), the standard enthalpy change of atomization of chlorine is:
(Cl–Cl bond energy 243 kJ mol⁻¹ (Table 6.1) le kar chlorine ki standard enthalpy change of atomization kitni hogi?)
blocks.explanation: ½Cl₂(g) → Cl(g) se aik mole gaseous atoms bante hain: 243/2 = +121.5 kJ mol⁻¹ (6.3.4).

book_ref.quote: The standard enthalpy change of atomization of an element is the enthalpy change involved

blocks.prompt:
25 The standard enthalpy change of neutralization is defined for the formation of:
(Standard enthalpy change of neutralization kis cheez ke banne ke liye define ki jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Neutralization: jab acid aur alkali se aik mole paani banta hai to enthalpy change (6.3.5).

book_ref.quote: when one mole of water is formed by the reaction of an acid with an alkali under standard conditions

blocks.prompt:
26 For all strong acid–strong base reactions, ΔH°n is always near:
(Tamam strong acid–strong base reactions ke liye ΔH°n hamesha kis ke qareeb hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sirf H⁺(aq) + OH⁻(aq) → H₂O(l) hota hai, is liye ΔH°n hamesha –57.1 kJ mol⁻¹ ke qareeb hai (6.3.5).

book_ref.quote: For all strong acid-base reactions ΔH°n is always near -57.1 kJ mol⁻¹.

blocks.prompt:
27 When NaOH(aq) and HCl(aq) are mixed, the only change that occurs is:
(Jab NaOH(aq) aur HCl(aq) milaye jate hain to sirf kaunsi tabdeeli hoti hai?)

options.text: H⁺ aur OH⁻ ions se paani banna
Na⁺ aur Cl⁻ ka atoms mein tootna

blocks.explanation: Na⁺ aur Cl⁻ aazad ions rehte hain; sirf H⁺(aq) + OH⁻(aq) → H₂O(l) hota hai (6.3.5).

book_ref.quote: the only change that occurs is the formation of water molecules leaving Na⁺ and Cl⁻ as free ions in solution

blocks.prompt:
28 How much heat is evolved when 0.25 mol of water is formed by neutralizing NaOH with HCl (ΔH°n = –57.1 kJ mol⁻¹)?
(NaOH ko HCl se neutralize karke 0.25 mol paani bane to kitni heat kharij hogi (ΔH°n = –57.1 kJ mol⁻¹)?)
blocks.explanation: Heat = 0.25 mol × 57.1 kJ mol⁻¹ = 14.3 kJ kharij (6.3.5).

book_ref.quote: It is always exothermic. For example, the enthalpy of neutralization of NaOH by HCl

blocks.prompt:
29 The first electron affinity is the enthalpy change when 1 mole of electrons is added to 1 mole of:
(First electron affinity woh enthalpy change hai jab 1 mole electrons kis ke 1 mole mein add kiye jayein?)

options.text: solid atoms mein, anions banane ke liye
gaseous atoms mein, gaseous uni-negative ions banane ke liye
gaseous cations mein, atoms banane ke liye
aqueous ions mein, molecules banane ke liye

blocks.explanation: First EA: 1 mol gaseous atoms mein 1 mol electrons add ho kar 1 mol gaseous uni-negative ions bante hain (6.3.6).

book_ref.quote: when 1 mole of electrons is added to 1 mole of gaseous atoms to form 1 mole of gaseous uni-negative ions

blocks.prompt:
30 The first electron affinity of chlorine is –348.8 kJ mol⁻¹. The negative sign shows that:
(Chlorine ki first electron affinity –348.8 kJ mol⁻¹ hai. Negative sign kya batata hai?)

options.text: Cl(g) ke electron lene par energy jazb hoti hai
Cl(g) ke electron lene par energy kharij hoti hai
qeemat solution mein naapi gayi hai

blocks.explanation: Energy kharij hoti hai, is liye first electron affinity negative hoti hai (6.3.6).

book_ref.quote: Since, energy is released, so first electron affinity carries negative sign.

blocks.text: 6.4 Bond energy (bond dissociation energy) and enthalpy changes

blocks.prompt:
31 Bond dissociation energy is the average amount of energy required to:
(Bond dissociation energy woh average energy hai jo kis kaam ke liye chahiye?)

options.text: kisi substance mein khaas bond ka aik mole todna
elements se aik mole compound banana
atoms se aik mole electrons nikalna

blocks.explanation: Bond dissociation energy: kisi substance mein khaas bond ke aik mole ko todne ki average energy (6.4).

book_ref.quote: The average amount of energy required to break (dissociate) one mole of a particular bond in a substance.

blocks.prompt:
32 When a bond is formed between two atoms:
(Jab do atoms ke darmiyan bond banta hai to:)

options.text: entropy hamesha zero ho jati hai

blocks.explanation: Bond banne par energy kharij hoti hai; utni hi energy bond todne par jazb hoti hai (6.4).

book_ref.quote: When a bond is formed between two atoms, energy is released.

blocks.prompt:
33 The energy of a particular bond in a particular substance (e.g. the C–C bond in ethane, 376 kJ mol⁻¹) is called:
(Kisi khaas substance mein khaas bond ki energy (maslan ethane mein C–C, 376 kJ mol⁻¹) ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Khaas substance mein bond energy exact bond energy hai; bohat se molecules ki average, average bond energy hai (6.4).

book_ref.quote: If we are determining bond energy of a particular bond in a particular substance, we call this exact bond energy.

blocks.prompt:
34 The C–C bond energies in ethane, propane and butane are 376, 356 and 352 kJ mol⁻¹. This shows that:
(Ethane, propane aur butane mein C–C bond energies 376, 356 aur 352 kJ mol⁻¹ hain. Is se kya pata chalta hai?)

options.text: tamam C–C bonds ki energy bilkul barabar hai
chain lambi hone se bond energy barhti hai
molecule ke doosre atoms bond energy par asar dalte hain

blocks.explanation: Same atoms ke bonds ki B.E. mukhtalif compounds mein mukhtalif hoti hai kyun ke molecule ke doosre atoms asar dalte hain (6.4).

book_ref.quote: For example, C–C bonds usually have B.E. values of approximately 350 to 380 kJ/mol.

blocks.prompt:
35 In practical calculations of ΔH from bond energies, we use:
(Bond energies se ΔH ke amli hisaab mein kya istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Amli tor par exact ki jagah average bond energies (Table 6.1) istemal hoti hain (6.4).

book_ref.quote: Practically, average bond energy is used instead of exact bond energies.

blocks.prompt:
36 According to Table 6.1, which bond has the highest average bond energy?
(Table 6.1 ke mutabiq kis bond ki average bond energy sab se zyada hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table 6.1 mein N≡N = 945 kJ mol⁻¹ hai, jo C≡C 812, O=O 498 aur H–H 436 kJ mol⁻¹ se zyada hai (6.4).

book_ref.quote: Table 6.1. Average Bond Energies of Some Important Bonds (kJ mol⁻¹)

blocks.text: 6.5 Enthalpy change of reaction and chemical bonds

blocks.prompt:
37 A chemical reaction is a process during which:
(Chemical reaction woh amal hai jis mein:)

options.text: purane bonds tootte aur naye bante hain

blocks.explanation: Chemical reaction mein purane bonds tootte aur naye bante hain; ΔHr isi se aata hai (6.5).

book_ref.quote: A chemical reaction is defined as a process during which old bonds are broken and new bonds are formed.

blocks.prompt:
38 Which statement about bond breaking and bond formation is correct?
(Bond todne aur banane ke baare mein kaunsa bayan durust hai?)

options.text: Bond todne mein energy kharij, banane mein jazb hoti hai
Bond todne mein energy jazb, banane mein kharij hoti hai
Dono mein energy kharij hoti hai
Dono mein energy jazb hoti hai

blocks.explanation: Bond todna: ΔH = +ve; bond banana: ΔH = –ve; in ka farq overall sign tay karta hai (6.5).

book_ref.quote: Bond breaking absorbs energy (ΔH = +ve) while bond formation releases it (ΔH = –ve)

blocks.prompt:
39 A reaction is exothermic when:
(Reaction exothermic kab hota hai?)

options.text: todne mein jazb energy, kharij energy se zyada ho
naye bonds banne mein kharij energy, todne mein jazb energy se zyada ho

blocks.explanation: Agar naye bond banne se zyada energy kharij ho bajaye tootne mein jazb hone ke, to reaction exothermic hai (6.5).

book_ref.quote: Overall reaction is exothermic if the energy released in making of new bonds is greater

blocks.prompt:
40 The formation of water from H₂ and O₂ is exothermic because:
(H₂ aur O₂ se paani banna exothermic kyun hai?)

options.text: H–H aur O=O todne ke liye energy nahi chahiye
H–O bonds banne par energy jazb hoti hai
H–O bonds banne mein kharij energy, H–H aur O=O todne ki energy se zyada hai

blocks.explanation: H–O bonds banne mein kharij energy, H–H aur O=O todne mein jazb energy se zyada hai (6.5).

book_ref.quote: the net reaction is exothermic because more energy is released in forming the H–O bonds

blocks.prompt:
41 Using EH–H = 436, EO=O = 498 and EH–O = 463 kJ mol⁻¹ (Table 6.1), ΔH for 2H₂(g) + O₂(g) → 2H₂O(g) is:
(EH–H = 436, EO=O = 498 aur EH–O = 463 kJ mol⁻¹ (Table 6.1) le kar 2H₂(g) + O₂(g) → 2H₂O(g) ka ΔH kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: EH–H = 436 kJ mol⁻¹ ; EO=O = 495 kJ mol⁻¹ and EH–O = 463 kJ mol⁻¹

blocks.text: 6.6 Measurement of the enthalpy change of a reaction

blocks.prompt:
42 The amount of heat evolved or absorbed during a physical or chemical change is measured by a:
(Physical ya chemical tabdeeli mein kharij ya jazb heat kis aale se naapi jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Calorimeter temperature ki tabdeeli naap kar kharij ya jazb heat maloom karta hai (6.6).

book_ref.quote: can be measured by an instrument called calorimeter

blocks.prompt:
43 At its simplest, a calorimeter consists of:
(Sab se saada calorimeter kis cheez par mushtamil hota hai?)

options.text: gas jar, stopcock aur vacuum pump

blocks.explanation: Saada calorimeter aik insulated bartan, stirrer aur thermometer hota hai (6.6).

book_ref.quote: At its simplest, a calorimeter consists of an insulated vessel, a stirrer and a thermometer.

blocks.prompt:
44 The specific heat capacity of water is:
(Paani ki specific heat capacity kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: 1 g paani ko 1 °C garam karne ke liye 4.18 J chahiye, is liye c = 4.18 J g⁻¹ K⁻¹ (= 4180 J kg⁻¹ K⁻¹) (6.6).

book_ref.quote: it takes 4.18J of energy to increase temperature of 1g of the water by 1°C

blocks.prompt:
45 How much heat is needed to raise the temperature of 250 g of water by 12 °C (c = 4.18 J g⁻¹ °C⁻¹)?
(250 g paani ka temperature 12 °C barhane ke liye kitni heat chahiye (c = 4.18 J g⁻¹ °C⁻¹)?)

book_ref.quote: The energy is transferred as heat and is shown by relationship

blocks.prompt:
46 A glass calorimeter is NOT suitable for:
(Glass calorimeter kis ke liye munasib NAHI hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gases bartan se nikal jayengi, aur bohat garam products wale reactions bhi munasib nahi (6.6.1).

book_ref.quote: However, it cannot be used for reactions involving gases which would escape from the vessel

blocks.prompt:
47 The outside walls of a glass calorimeter are insulated with cotton wool to:
(Glass calorimeter ki bahar ki deewaron ko cotton wool se kyun dhanpa jata hai?)

options.text: gases ko andar rakhne ke liye
aas paas ki hawa se heat ka len-den kam karne ke liye

blocks.explanation: Cotton wool hawa ke saath heat ke len-den ko kam karti hai (6.6.1).

book_ref.quote: The outside walls of the calorimeter (beaker) are insulated using cotton wool

blocks.prompt:
48 The loose-fitting lid of a glass calorimeter keeps the contents at atmospheric pressure, so the heat measured equals:
(Glass calorimeter ka dheela dhakkan contents ko atmospheric pressure par rakhta hai, is liye naapi gayi heat barabar hai:)
blocks.explanation: Andar pressure constant hai, is liye temperature ki naap se enthalpy change ΔH milta hai (6.6.1).

book_ref.quote: a loose-fitting lid to keep the contents at atmospheric pressure

blocks.prompt:
49 In glass-calorimeter calculations the specific heat capacity of water is used for the solution because:
(Glass calorimeter ke hisaab mein solution ke liye paani ki specific heat kyun li jati hai?)

options.text: solutions itne patle hain ke un ki mass taqreeban sab paani hai
solute ki specific heat zyada hai

blocks.explanation: Patle (dilute) solutions ki mass taqreeban sab paani hoti hai, is liye paani ki c li jati hai (6.6.1).

book_ref.quote: The solutions we are using here are so dilute that almost all of their mass consists of water

blocks.prompt:
50 50 cm³ of 1.0 mol dm⁻³ HCl is mixed with 50 cm³ of 1.0 mol dm⁻³ NaOH and the temperature rises by 6.8 K. Taking the mass as 100 g and c = 4.2 J g⁻¹ K⁻¹, ΔH°n is:
(50 cm³ 1.0 mol dm⁻³ HCl ko 50 cm³ 1.0 mol dm⁻³ NaOH se milaya, temperature 6.8 K barha. Mass 100 g aur c = 4.2 J g⁻¹ K⁻¹ le kar ΔH°n kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: Neutralization of 100 cm³ of 0.5 moldm⁻³ NaOH at 25°C

blocks.prompt:
51 How many moles of water are formed when 200 cm³ of 0.25 mol dm⁻³ HCl reacts completely with excess NaOH?
(200 cm³ 0.25 mol dm⁻³ HCl zyada NaOH se poora react kare to kitne moles paani banega?)
blocks.explanation: n = concentration × volume (dm³) = 0.25 × 0.200 = 0.050 mol HCl, is se 0.050 mol H₂O (6.6.1).

book_ref.quote: Calculation of n (no. of moles of H₂O formed): Using mole = Concentration(mol/dm³) x Volume (dm³)

blocks.text: 6.7 Enthalpy change and calorie content of food

blocks.prompt:
52 The energy released when food is digested in the body is:
(Jism mein khurak hazm hone par kharij hone wali energy:)

options.text: bahar jalne ke aadhe se kam
utni hi jitni jism ke bahar jalne par

blocks.explanation: Hazm hone par utni hi energy kharij hoti hai jitni jism ke bahar jalne par, is liye combustion ka ΔH calorie content deta hai (6.7).

book_ref.quote: digestion of food releases same amount of energy as it is burned outside the body

blocks.prompt:
53 The heat of combustion of a food is typically determined in a:
(Khurak ki heat of combustion aam tor par kis mein naapi jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Khurak ki enthalpy of combustion aam tor par bomb calorimeter mein naapi jati hai (6.7).

book_ref.quote: which can be determined in a calorimeter (typically in a bomb calorimeter)

blocks.prompt:
54 The calorie content of food is typically expressed in:
(Khurak ka calorie content aam tor par kin units mein bataya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Calorie content kilocalories (kcal) ya joules (J) mein hota hai (6.7).

book_ref.quote: This energy is typically expressed in units of kilocalories (k cal) or joules (J).

blocks.prompt:
55 Glucose burns with ΔH° = –2803 kJ mol⁻¹ (molar mass 180 g mol⁻¹). How much energy is released by 45 g of glucose?
(Glucose ΔH° = –2803 kJ mol⁻¹ ke saath jalta hai (molar mass 180 g mol⁻¹). 45 g glucose se kitni energy kharij hogi?)

book_ref.quote: Molar mass of glucose is 180gmol⁻¹. Above equation shows that;
